verdict.rationale: The only machine-to-machine channel in evidence is EFILE/ReFILE: CRA-certified tax software and enrolled electronic filers transmit returns system-to-system. That path is gated behind software certification and filer enrollment, and covers only return filing, not a general public API. Everything else (business registration, payments, documents, enquiries) is offered as web portal e-services, and the llms.txt probe found no agent-oriented docs index. Missing for 10: a publicly documented open API spec, self-serve developer access without certification, API coverage beyond return transmission (registration, payments, account management), and agent-oriented docs.
